<script type="text/javascript">
const seoBtn = document.getElementById("seo-btn");
const mediaBtn = document.getElementById("media-btn");
const marketBtn = document.getElementById("market-btn");
const seo = document.getElementById("seo");
const media = document.getElementById("media");
const market = document.getElementById("market");

seoBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "flex";
  media.style.display = "none";
  market.style.display = "none";
  seoBtn.classList.add("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.remove("active");
  marketBtn.classList.remove("active");
});

mediaBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "none";
  media.style.display = "flex";
  market.style.display = "none";
  seoBtn.classList.remove("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.add("active");
  marketBtn.classList.remove("active");
});
marketBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "none";
  media.style.display = "none";
  market.style.display = "flex";
  seoBtn.classList.remove("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.remove("active");
  marketBtn.classList.add("active");
});

const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in');
const options = {
  root: null,
  rootMargin: '0px',
  threshold: .4
}
const callbacks = (entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting){
      entry.target.classList.add('active');
    }
  });
}
let observer = new IntersectionObserver(callbacks, options);
elements.forEach(element => {
  observer.observe(element);
});
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
const seoBtn = document.getElementById("seo-btn");
const mediaBtn = document.getElementById("media-btn");
const marketBtn = document.getElementById("market-btn");
const seo = document.getElementById("seo");
const media = document.getElementById("media");
const market = document.getElementById("market");

seoBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "flex";
  media.style.display = "none";
  market.style.display = "none";
  seoBtn.classList.add("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.remove("active");
  marketBtn.classList.remove("active");
});

mediaBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "none";
  media.style.display = "flex";
  market.style.display = "none";
  seoBtn.classList.remove("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.add("active");
  marketBtn.classList.remove("active");
});
marketBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "none";
  media.style.display = "none";
  market.style.display = "flex";
  seoBtn.classList.remove("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.remove("active");
  marketBtn.classList.add("active");
});

const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in');
const options = {
  root: null,
  rootMargin: '0px',
  threshold: .4
}
const callbacks = (entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting){
      entry.target.classList.add('active');
    }
  });
}
let observer = new IntersectionObserver(callbacks, options);
elements.forEach(element => {
  observer.observe(element);
});
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
const seoBtn = document.getElementById("seo-btn");
const mediaBtn = document.getElementById("media-btn");
const marketBtn = document.getElementById("market-btn");
const seo = document.getElementById("seo");
const media = document.getElementById("media");
const market = document.getElementById("market");

seoBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "flex";
  media.style.display = "none";
  market.style.display = "none";
  seoBtn.classList.add("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.remove("active");
  marketBtn.classList.remove("active");
});

mediaBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "none";
  media.style.display = "flex";
  market.style.display = "none";
  seoBtn.classList.remove("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.add("active");
  marketBtn.classList.remove("active");
});
marketBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "none";
  media.style.display = "none";
  market.style.display = "flex";
  seoBtn.classList.remove("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.remove("active");
  marketBtn.classList.add("active");
});

const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in');
const options = {
  root: null,
  rootMargin: '0px',
  threshold: .4
}
const callbacks = (entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting){
      entry.target.classList.add('active');
    }
  });
}
let observer = new IntersectionObserver(callbacks, options);
elements.forEach(element => {
  observer.observe(element);
});
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
const seoBtn = document.getElementById("seo-btn");
const mediaBtn = document.getElementById("media-btn");
const marketBtn = document.getElementById("market-btn");
const seo = document.getElementById("seo");
const media = document.getElementById("media");
const market = document.getElementById("market");

seoBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "flex";
  media.style.display = "none";
  market.style.display = "none";
  seoBtn.classList.add("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.remove("active");
  marketBtn.classList.remove("active");
});

mediaBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "none";
  media.style.display = "flex";
  market.style.display = "none";
  seoBtn.classList.remove("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.add("active");
  marketBtn.classList.remove("active");
});
marketBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "none";
  media.style.display = "none";
  market.style.display = "flex";
  seoBtn.classList.remove("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.remove("active");
  marketBtn.classList.add("active");
});

const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in');
const options = {
  root: null,
  rootMargin: '0px',
  threshold: .4
}
const callbacks = (entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting){
      entry.target.classList.add('active');
    }
  });
}
let observer = new IntersectionObserver(callbacks, options);
elements.forEach(element => {
  observer.observe(element);
});
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
const seoBtn = document.getElementById("seo-btn");
const mediaBtn = document.getElementById("media-btn");
const marketBtn = document.getElementById("market-btn");
const seo = document.getElementById("seo");
const media = document.getElementById("media");
const market = document.getElementById("market");

seoBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "flex";
  media.style.display = "none";
  market.style.display = "none";
  seoBtn.classList.add("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.remove("active");
  marketBtn.classList.remove("active");
});

mediaBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "none";
  media.style.display = "flex";
  market.style.display = "none";
  seoBtn.classList.remove("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.add("active");
  marketBtn.classList.remove("active");
});
marketBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "none";
  media.style.display = "none";
  market.style.display = "flex";
  seoBtn.classList.remove("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.remove("active");
  marketBtn.classList.add("active");
});

const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in');
const options = {
  root: null,
  rootMargin: '0px',
  threshold: .4
}
const callbacks = (entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting){
      entry.target.classList.add('active');
    }
  });
}
let observer = new IntersectionObserver(callbacks, options);
elements.forEach(element => {
  observer.observe(element);
});
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
const seoBtn = document.getElementById("seo-btn");
const mediaBtn = document.getElementById("media-btn");
const marketBtn = document.getElementById("market-btn");
const seo = document.getElementById("seo");
const media = document.getElementById("media");
const market = document.getElementById("market");

seoBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "flex";
  media.style.display = "none";
  market.style.display = "none";
  seoBtn.classList.add("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.remove("active");
  marketBtn.classList.remove("active");
});

mediaBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "none";
  media.style.display = "flex";
  market.style.display = "none";
  seoBtn.classList.remove("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.add("active");
  marketBtn.classList.remove("active");
});
marketBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "none";
  media.style.display = "none";
  market.style.display = "flex";
  seoBtn.classList.remove("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.remove("active");
  marketBtn.classList.add("active");
});

const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in');
const options = {
  root: null,
  rootMargin: '0px',
  threshold: .4
}
const callbacks = (entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting){
      entry.target.classList.add('active');
    }
  });
}
let observer = new IntersectionObserver(callbacks, options);
elements.forEach(element => {
  observer.observe(element);
});
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
const seoBtn = document.getElementById("seo-btn");
const mediaBtn = document.getElementById("media-btn");
const marketBtn = document.getElementById("market-btn");
const seo = document.getElementById("seo");
const media = document.getElementById("media");
const market = document.getElementById("market");

seoBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "flex";
  media.style.display = "none";
  market.style.display = "none";
  seoBtn.classList.add("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.remove("active");
  marketBtn.classList.remove("active");
});

mediaBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "none";
  media.style.display = "flex";
  market.style.display = "none";
  seoBtn.classList.remove("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.add("active");
  marketBtn.classList.remove("active");
});
marketBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
  seo.style.display = "none";
  media.style.display = "none";
  market.style.display = "flex";
  seoBtn.classList.remove("active");
  mediaBtn.classList.remove("active");
  marketBtn.classList.add("active");
});

const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in');
const options = {
  root: null,
  rootMargin: '0px',
  threshold: .4
}
const callbacks = (entries) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting){
      entry.target.classList.add('active');
    }
  });
}
let observer = new IntersectionObserver(callbacks, options);
elements.forEach(element => {
  observer.observe(element);
});
</script>
